why: FLUX.2-klein-9B's class-level architecture config, cached so the catalog declaration has a durable, checkable source. pgw#1346 B1 recorded that no 9B transformer config.json exists on the authoring box and that the two klein-9b endpoints deliberately carry no checkpoint ref (ie#524/th#980 makes the ref a deploy-time binding), which left the 9B declaration with nothing to derive its width from. These are the published CONFIGS, not weights: seven JSON files, 4.8 KB in total, fetched from the serving release's own tree.
not_weights: Every file here is a config document. No tensor bytes were fetched, and none may be added to this directory.

source.route: GET /api/v1/repos/{org}/{name}/resolve?release={release}&digest={checkpoint_id} -> per-file presigned R2 GETs; only the config-sized entries were read

releases.note: the step-distilled checkpoint; its own model_index.json carries is_distilled=true

the undistilled reference checkpoint; identical tree layout, and its text_encoder/scheduler/vae configs are byte-identical to turbo's (same digests), so only its transformer config and model_index are cached separately

verification: tests/test_flux2_klein_9b_pgw1346.py re-hashes every file above against the digest recorded here, so a silently edited fixture fails rather than re-keying the declaration.
